subtasks.name: Distinct agent ids for sessions started from inside another session
subtasks.description: A claude process launched from inside another Claude Code session inherits its session id, so both get the same agent id and the second can re-claim the first's task. Seen in the T-19 dry run. Add something unique per process, or detect the inherited id.

log.text: linked https://github.com/sirashton/MVPlanner/pull/9; PR #9 open. The first live process to use a session id owns it; nested processes get a -p<pid> suffix; resumed sessions keep their id. Merging when CI is green.

status In Progress -> Complete; Merged in PR #9. Handoff: nested claude processes share the parent's session_id and transcript path, and only CLAUDE_PID differs. Ownership records live in CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/sessions/owners/<session>.json. Without CLAUDE_PID, behaviour is unchanged.

subtasks.name: Enforce claims by default in new plans

subtasks.name: Shared context: notes and questions on tasks
subtasks.description: The plan becomes a context store: what each agent learned is kept on its task, and agents are briefed with the notes that matter to their task.

subtasks.name: Handoff note required to complete a task
subtasks.description: When completing a task, the agent writes a short note: what changed, decisions and why, gotchas, what it left out (with T-ids) and where to look. Kept per task on the plan branch.

subtasks.name: Briefings include notes from related tasks
subtasks.description: Claiming a task shows notes from the task itself, its parent, its siblings and the tasks it depends on, within a size budget.

subtasks.name: Session link on every claim
subtasks.description: Store the session or thread link with each claim, so the transcript behind a task can be found without copying it anywhere.

subtasks.name: Questions on tasks
subtasks.description: An agent can ask a question on a task; the agent that did it sees it on its next plan call, and others see it in briefings. Unanswered ones show in the panel and page.
